rationale: The agent message indicates the order was cancelled and a refund initiated without any visible authentication of the user, verification of the correct order, or explicit confirmation from the user prior to an order-changing action. The user asked first about splitting payment, then possibly removing the most expensive item, then downgrading items, and only if those were not possible, cancelling the whole order. The agent skipped these steps and did not confirm before executing a cancellation. There is also no tool call evidence shown (e.g., find user, get order details, or cancel order) to support the stated outcome. This violates the policy requirements to authenticate, confirm before writes, and act only on the user's orders with proper verification. Therefore, it fails the pass bar.
